name: Flooring
summary: Professional flooring installation, replacement and repair for luxury vinyl plank, engineered wood, laminate, tile, baseboards, transitions and subfloor preparation throughout Dallas–Fort Worth.

faqs.question: Which flooring works well for busy households?
faqs.answer: Luxury vinyl plank and quality porcelain tile are popular for active homes because they provide durable surfaces, practical maintenance and a wide range of styles. The best option also depends on moisture exposure, pets, traffic and the condition of the subfloor.

faqs.question: Do floors need leveling before installation?
faqs.answer: Some properties require patching, grinding or leveling so the finished floor lies flat and performs correctly. The existing surface and subfloor should be evaluated before installation begins.

faqs.question: Can damaged flooring be repaired without replacing the entire room?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. Individual planks, tiles, transitions or small sections may be replaceable when matching material is available and the surrounding floor is still in good condition.

faqs.question: Can you replace flooring after a water-damage loss?
faqs.answer: Yes. After the affected area has been stabilized and properly dried, flooring, underlayment, baseboards and related finishes can be replaced as part of the reconstruction scope.

faqs.question: What is included in a complete flooring installation?
faqs.answer: A complete scope may include removal, disposal, subfloor preparation, underlayment, flooring installation, transitions, baseboards or shoe molding, caulking and final cleanup, depending on the project.
